title: Law on Idolatry and the Central Court
description: Moses gives laws on how idolatry is to be handled: Anyone who worships other gods, the sun, the moon, or the host of heaven shall, after thorough investigation, be stoned to death at the city gate. Two or three witnesses are required to pronounce a death sentence, and the witnesses must be the first to lay hands on the guilty person. Difficult legal cases are to be brought to the Levitical priests and the judge in the place the Lord chooses, and the people must follow their ruling without turning aside to the right or to the left. Anyone who defies this authority shall die, so that all the people will hear it and fear.
